challenge.challenge_name: Virtual Embryo Challenge: Generative Modeling of Embryogenesis Across Space, Scale and Time
challenge.full_name: Virtual Embryo Challenge: Generative Modeling of Embryogenesis Across Space, Scale and Time

clinical_domain.clinical_context: Computational developmental biology and spatial/single-cell transcriptomics; excluded from the imaging-task analytical scope.

input: single-cell RNA profiles from earlier stages
earlier-stage 3D MERFISH-derived cell locations and gene expression
output: future-stage gene expression and 3D cell locations

input: wild-type development and one observed perturbation in 3D MERFISH data
output: held-out mutant cell expression and 3D locations

cell_count.unit: cells across eleven developmental time points

data_components: Serial-section 3D MERFISH-derived spatial transcriptomics for Tasks 2 and 3
dataset.upstream_acquisition_note: Tasks 2–3 use processed MERFISH-derived spatial transcriptomic coordinates and expression; no raw-image task is established. Previously coded Microscopy described upstream acquisition, not the competition input modality.

data_access.license_or_terms: Research/educational use; publication or presentation using unpublished competition data requires data-generator approval

testing.submission_artifact: AnnData predictions with gene-expression matrices and, for spatial tasks, 3D coordinates

submission.submission_type: Predicted AnnData files; agent-designed track additionally requires design trajectory evidence

notes: Do not use December 2026 scheduled awards as evidence of completed final evaluation on the October 20 documentary review date.

provenance.collection_date_description: Documentary extraction date, not competition completion date.

sources.basis: The Virtual Embryo Challenge is one of the 16 accepted NeurIPS 2026 competitions.
The organizer schedules final submissions for December 2, evaluation for December 4, and winner announcement for December 11, 2026.
Tasks 2 and 3 use 3D locations from serial-section MERFISH microscopy, alongside expression profiles; Task 1 is RNA-only.
Human-designed and agent-designed method tracks are compared on common hidden tests.

review_coding.basis: Competition inputs/targets are single-cell expression profiles, processed spatial transcriptomic coordinates, future expression distributions and genetic perturbation responses. Under this review’s task-based imaging scope, upstream MERFISH imaging origin alone does not establish an image-analysis objective.
review_coding.supersedes: Previous imaging-derived boundary inclusion; user-reviewed task-based exclusion on 2026-10-21.

eligibility_review.reason: Competition inputs/targets are single-cell expression profiles, processed spatial transcriptomic coordinates, future expression distributions and genetic perturbation responses. Under this review’s task-based imaging scope, upstream MERFISH imaging origin alone does not establish an image-analysis objective.
eligibility_review.scope_qualification: Some source data are imaging-derived. Exclusion is a review-scope decision, not a claim that spatial transcriptomics has no imaging component.
eligibility_review.aggregate_application_status: Exclusion recorded in original JSON and review queue; manuscript and aggregate denominator not yet rebuilt.

previous_review_coding.imaging_scope: Only Tasks 2 and 3 are imaging-derived; Task 1 is RNA-only.
previous_review_coding.basis: MERFISH sections are imaged and reconstructed into 3D spatial coordinates central to two assessed tasks; the agent track concerns method design, not clinical tool use.

previous_scope_notes: Boundary inclusion under Supplementary Methods SM1: multimodal editions are eligible when imaging or an image-derived representation is integral to at least one assessed task.
The Task 1 RNA-only subtask is retained within the edition but is not independently counted as an imaging challenge.
The human-designed and agent-designed tracks use the same three tasks; count one 2026 edition, not two tracks.
